data.one_liner: Facilitates infinite scroll and pull-to-refresh features for the RxBloc ecosystem.
data.what_it_does: The rx_bloc_list package provides the RxPaginatedBuilder widget and extensions to easily implement pagination, infinity scroll, and pull-to-refresh. It integrates seamlessly with the RxBloc state management ecosystem.
use_when: You are building an app using the RxBloc ecosystem and need paginated lists.
You want a straightforward way to add infinity scroll and pull-to-refresh to your UI.
avoid_when: You are not using the RxBloc ecosystem or reactive streams for state management.
You prefer alternative state management solutions like Riverpod or Provider.
strengths: Simplifies implementing infinity scroll and pull-to-refresh.
Provides built-in support for refresh indicators and list item state management.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the RxBloc ecosystem.
Limited usefulness if not using streams for pagination.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package in your Dart code.
